name: Electric Kick Scooter
description: A stand-up scooter with a deck, handlebar steering and no seat or pedals, whose battery-electric motors total no more than 500 W and can't propel it past 25 km/h, allowed on public roads only under a provincial pilot project.

restrictions.rule: Up to four wheels no more than 430 mm in diameter, one or two at each end, a standing platform and a handlebar acting directly on the front wheels; no pedals, seat or enclosure
restrictions.citation: Electric Kick Scooter Pilot Project Regulation, B.C. Reg. 247/2023, s. 3(1)

restrictions.rule: Battery-powered electric motors with a total continuous power output rating of no more than 500 W that can't propel it past 25 km/h on a clean, paved, level surface
restrictions.citation: Electric Kick Scooter Pilot Project Regulation, B.C. Reg. 247/2023, s. 3(2)

restrictions.rule: Weighs no more than 45 kg unladen and must stop within 7.5 m from 25 km/h; the motor stops when the rider releases the accelerator or brakes
restrictions.citation: Electric Kick Scooter Pilot Project Regulation, B.C. Reg. 247/2023, ss. 32 to 34

restrictions.rule: Riders must be 16 or older and wear a bicycle safety helmet
restrictions.citation: Electric Kick Scooter Pilot Project Regulation, B.C. Reg. 247/2023, ss. 7 and 19

restrictions.rule: Inside a municipality it's allowed only if the municipality has joined the pilot, and the municipality can still ban it from any road by bylaw or sign
restrictions.citation: Electric Kick Scooter Pilot Project Regulation, B.C. Reg. 247/2023, ss. 5 and 8

restrictions.rule: Rides in the cycle lane where there is one; without one, only where a sign or bylaw allows it, or at the right edge of a road posted 50 km/h or less in a participating community
restrictions.citation: Electric Kick Scooter Pilot Project Regulation, B.C. Reg. 247/2023, ss. 10, 11 and 16

restrictions.rule: Not allowed on sidewalks or crosswalks unless a sign allows it
restrictions.citation: Electric Kick Scooter Pilot Project Regulation, B.C. Reg. 247/2023, ss. 12, 13, 17 and 18

restrictions.rule: No passengers or towing; the rider stands on the platform with at least one hand on the handlebar
restrictions.citation: Electric Kick Scooter Pilot Project Regulation, B.C. Reg. 247/2023, ss. 26 and 28

restrictions.rule: Has a vehicle driver's rights and duties under Part 3 of the Motor Vehicle Act
restrictions.citation: Electric Kick Scooter Pilot Project Regulation, B.C. Reg. 247/2023, s. 30

restrictions.rule: Deemed a designated personal mobility device, not a motor vehicle or motor assisted cycle: no driver's licence or insurance
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 1; Electric Kick Scooter Pilot Project Regulation, B.C. Reg. 247/2023, ss. 3(1) and 4(3)
